rules.description: Fail errors or exceptions that are caught, ignored, or discarded without handling, logging, wrapping, or rethrowing. Intentional best-effort operations pass when the intent is clear.
The code is not unnecessarily complicated.

Comments must state a constraint, invariant, or rationale a reader cannot infer from the code. Fail comments that narrate development history or verification steps (for example "verified in a live session"), restate the identifier name, or describe what the following code does. JSDoc on exported symbols is not exempt.
